notes.title: Tiny update - Unity 6
notes.content: This is a minor build update to Unity 6, which might bring a few performance improvements.

notes.title: Progression Update 0.1
notes.content:
This update brings the beginning of a progression system to the game, something that will take some time to complete but it'll be worth the wait! More info to come in a future post about this, so look out for it!

[list]
[*] Added [b]60[/b] progressive stages to the Today's Goal splines. They should feel more authored and gradually get harder as you go through them.
[*] Urgent Task splines currently have [b]5[/b] stages each and there are 3 sets of them so far.
[*] When beginning a game for the first time, you have a Yes/No choice to do the Tutorial.
[*] Continuing the game should put you back on the spline set you previously left off from.
[*] And more minor bug fixes and improvements 
[/list]

notes.title: Small Bug Fix - Apr 6th
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Tutorial mode wasn't showing on first launch - should now be fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Super-close-to-early-access-release build
notes.content:
This update is for the 0.92 release of Bugged. It has a whole bunch of changes and updates.

- During the game, timed challenges pop up at random that you must complete.

- There are multiple promotion titles you can achieve once you finish 'Today's Goal' events.

- Some visual updates and control responsiveness updates

As the game progresses through early access, I will be posting more updates here, both major and minor!
